units.title: Energy Systems and Sustainable Development Framework
topics: Introduction to Sustainable Development Goals related to energy systems
Overview of global and Indian energy consumption and future trends
Primary and secondary energy resources include conventional and renewable sources
Energy–environment interactions and energy needs of a developing economy
Energy security
import dependency, and long-term energy transition pathways
Energy policy framework in India including National Energy Policy
National Electricity Plan, and National Hydrogen Mission

units.title: Renewable Energy Technologies for India
topics: Solar photovoltaic and solar thermal energy systems
Onshore and offshore wind energy technologies and applications
Small and large hydropower systems
Biomass
biogas
compressed biogas, and biofuels
Hybrid renewable energy systems and integration challenges
Role of renewables in India’s non-fossil energy capacity expansion
Solar PV manufacturing ecosystem and PLI scheme overview

units.title: Bioenergy and Waste-to-Energy Systems
topics: Bioenergy potential and resources in India
Utilization of agricultural residues and municipal solid waste
Anaerobic digestion and biogas production principles
Biogas upgrading and Bio-CNG production routes
Thermal conversion technologies including gasification and pyrolysis
Role of bioenergy in circular economy
Case studies of Indian waste to energy and bio CNG plants

units.title: Hydrogen and Energy Storage Technologies
topics: Green hydrogen production through electrolysis
Hydrogen safety
storage
transportation and industrial applications
Green ammonia
green methanol, and synthetic fuels
Battery energy storage systems
Pumped hydro
thermal, and hybrid energy storage technologies
Role of hydrogen in hard to abate sectors such as steel
cement, and refineries

units.title: Global Energy Transition and Advanced Energy Systems
topics: Net-zero energy systems and global transition timelines
Energy transition pathways and future scenarios
Electrification of transport and industrial sectors
Advanced and long-duration energy storage concepts
Critical energy materials
supply chains, and geopolitics
Digitalization and AI applications in energy systems
Smart grids and demand side management using AI
